gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists in the report (notes: 'No business-type detail schedules'), so detail[] has no utility lines. The JSON statement receipts are the p6 Totals rows User Fees, Other Services Fees, Intergovernmental, Miscellaneous income, Interest Income (6,999,153). Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p11), per fund column: Rescue Squad 50,734 + 40,336 + 7,861 + 82 = 99,013; Water 674,472 + 17,040 + 11,654 + 10,084 + 518 = 713,768; Sewer 288,273 + 187 = 288,460; Solid Waste 93,365 + 74 = 93,439; Care Center 5,328,552 + 459,904 + 12,541 + 3,476 = 5,804,473. Sum 6,999,153 = statement total (each row also ties to its Totals cell: 6,435,396; 17,040; 511,894; 30,747; 4,076). Transfers In/Out print '-' in every column. Category = the statement row's category; G&A keeps the statement's hospital/health care category.
